questions.question: What does the fall in Aviva's commercial lines premiums indicate, according to the brief?

The Direct Line deal removed commercial contracts
Softer pricing is weighing on business insurance
Claims costs forced Aviva to cut back underwriting

questions.question: If brokers increasingly steer third-party capital through vehicles like Cortina, who may face new competition?
options: Brokers who place primary insurance for retail clients
Lead underwriters who set terms on Lloyd's syndicates
Hedge funds that invest in catastrophe bonds
Established reinsurers that traditionally follow a lead underwriter at Lloyd's

questions.question: Why were investors treating Nvidia's leadership shock as significant for the chip sector?
options: It signalled Nvidia would cut its earnings guidance
It tests Nvidia's dominance and moved money to rival chipmakers
It triggered a sector-wide regulatory investigation
It forced Nvidia to delay its quarterly earnings report
questions.explanation: Investors saw the shock as a test of Nvidia's dominance and rotated into rivals like AMD and Broadcom.

questions.question: What does Nvidia's private confirmation about chip tracking imply for the debate over export controls?

The Semiconductor Industry Association will drop its membership rules
Chip makers will be exempt from the Chip Security Act
Chip sales to China will rise as tracking reassures regulators

questions.question: What does Microsoft ruling out a cyber attack as the outage's cause suggest?
options: A fault at a third-party cloud provider that is already resolved
A deliberate internal shutdown of services
A technical fault, with disruption possibly continuing since fixes have failed
A planned maintenance window that overran

questions.question: Why does the Microsoft outage matter to many workplaces?
options: Copilot is used to run payroll and settlement systems
Teams and Outlook are core tools for daily communication and client contact
The outage exposes customer data held in Outlook
Microsoft will have to refund subscription fees
questions.explanation: Because Teams and Outlook underpin daily communication, an outage interrupts routine work and client contact.

questions.question: In the sector tilt trade, what would break the relative-value spread?
options: Construction recovering or the AI-driven services boom fading
A broad market fall that hits all sectors equally
Services and construction both growing at the same pace as the market
A rise in the UK capital gains tax rate
questions.explanation: The trade depends on the performance gap, so a recovery in construction or a services fade would close it.
